name: SAUNABOX Forge 1-Person: Traditional Finnish Sauna
description: Meet the Forge™ — a precision-built outdoor sauna crafted for those who take recovery seriously. Designed with architectural intention and wrapped in 100% Canadian Hemlock, Forge blends natural warmth with modern edge. Clean lines. Black-tinted tempered glass. Soft ambient lighting. Every detail is engineered to elevate the ritual. The powerful 3.5 kW wall-mounted heater reaches temperatures up to 220°F , delivering a deep, enveloping heat that rivals traditional spa-grade saunas. Built for outdoor performance and year-round durability, Forge is weather-resistant and engineered to withstand the elements—rain, sun, and snow alike. Key Features 100% Canadian Hemlock Construction Naturally aromatic, sustainably sourced, moisture-resistant, and built to last. Reaches Up to 220°F Deep, immersive heat for serious sweat sessions. 3.5kW Wall-Mounted Heater Powerful, consistent performance. Black-Tinted Tempered Glass Door Sleek privacy with a modern architectural feel Integrated Ambient Lighting Soft illumination designed for a calming, refined atmosphere. Weather-Resistant Outdoor Design Built specifically for exterior installation. Complete Accessory Kit Included Sauna rocks, water bucket & ladle, and wooden foot stool. Product Specifications • Harvia Vega Compact 3.5 kW electric heater — Finnish commercial-grade, the same unit used in professional spa installations worldwide • Heats to 170°F in approximately 25 minutes from a cold start • Heats to 220°F in approximately 40 minutes from a cold start • Full-length tempered glass door with matte black hinges and Saunabox-branded horizontal pull handle • Matte black aluminum exterior paneling over a cedar frame — built for year-round outdoor use • Canadian hemlock interior — light-toned, low-resin, low-odor wood that stays cool to the touch at full temperature • Single bench with ergonomic S-shaped backrest for extended, comfortable sessions • RGB LED ambient lighting (color-selectable) under the bench and overhead • Slatted wood flooring — elevated for drainage and barefoot comfort • Active ventilation system: 1 fan + 2 vents (intake + exhaust) • Louvered black vent panel on the exterior for passive airflow • Raised feet for ground clearance — promotes drainage and airflow underneath the cabin • Hardwired 240V installation — no cords, no adapters, permanent setup • Compact outdoor footprint: 1.10 m wide × 1.05 m deep (43.3 × 41.3 in) • Matte black hardware throughout — hinges, handle, vent panel, and accessories DIMENSIONS Exterior • External Height: 2.05 m / 6′ 8¾″ (80.71 in) • External Width: 1.10 m / 3′ 7⁵⁄₁₆″ (43.31
